All times are local clock times for one day. No dates or time zones are assigned. This CSV is a planning sheet, not a reservation or a Cowlendar import file.

Which appointment start times fit before closing?

Enter the first possible start and the latest time a service may finish. Set the minutes customers spend in an appointment and the buffer needed between bookable starts. If the business closes for a break, the generator builds the morning and afternoon independently. Give each start a capacity of one for a private appointment or the number of seats available for a group session.

Slots per uninterrupted period = floor((available minutes + buffer) ÷ (service minutes + buffer))

Publish appointment availability on Shopify →

Worked example

A studio runs 45-minute appointments with 15 minutes between starts from 09:00 to 12:00. Customers can book 09:00, 10:00 or 11:00. At a capacity of three people per start, that morning offers nine bookable places.

Appointment Time Slot Generator FAQ

Does buffer time change the length shown to the customer?

The service duration determines the appointment’s start and finish. The buffer adds space before another appointment may begin, so a 30-minute service with a ten-minute buffer starts again 40 minutes after the previous start.

Can a slot extend into the lunch break?

A service must finish within its working period. If it would run into the break, that start is skipped. The first afternoon slot begins when the break ends.

Why is there time left over at the end of the day?

A remaining interval shorter than the full service cannot fit another customer. Moving the opening time, reducing the buffer or offering a separately scheduled shorter service can change the result.

What does capacity per slot mean for a group class?

Capacity is the number of bookable places sharing the same start and finish. Four starts with six seats each offer 24 places. Use one place for a private appointment.

Does the CSV contain calendar dates and time zones?

It contains local starts, ends and capacity for a working day. Use the recurring class schedule generator when you need dated sessions and a time zone for calendar import.

How do I account for several different staff schedules?

Generate each distinct working period separately. If staff also share limited rooms, chairs or equipment, check those constraints before offering the combined appointments.
